title: Effect of egg white peptides‑selenium chelate against APAP-induced damage in HepG2 cells and C. elegans via Nrf2 signaling.
authors: Wu, Yuwei; Pei, Yiqiao; Wang, Wenjie; Du, Siyu; Shang, Fengshi; Liu, Zhifu; Liu, Rui; Zhang, Ye; Wang, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蛋清肽-硒螯合物通过Nrf2信号通路缓解APAP肝损伤，涉及肽与Keap-1蛋白的分子对接，但核心是细胞/线虫实验与氧化应激，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Overdose of acetaminophen (APAP) can cause severe liver injury, and selenium chelating peptide is a promising treatment strategy. This study optimized the chelation process of sodium selenite with egg white protein-hydrolyzed peptides and obtained two highly active peptides (WHCSeMAQ and FMSeCSeFFV) after ultrafiltration, LC-MS and batch docking screening, which could bind to Keap-1 via hydrogen and hydrophobic bonds, promoting Nrf2 release. The two peptides attenuated APAP-induced liver injury in HepG2 cell by modulating the Nrf2 pathway, enhancing the activities of antioxidant enzyme activities GSH-Px, CAT, and SOD, and decreasing ROS and MDA levels. In addition, egg white peptides‑selenium chelate (EWP-Se) was able to prolong the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans, reduce ROS levels, and upregulate SKN-1 target genes to promote GST-4 expression. This study shown selenium-peptides had a great potential as protective agents against liver injury and provided theoretical support for the development of selenium chelated peptide foods with health-promoting properties.
abstract_zh: 对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）过量可导致严重肝损伤，而硒螯合肽是一种有前景的治疗策略。本研究优化了亚硒酸钠与蛋清水解肽的螯合工艺，并通过超滤、液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）及批量对接筛选获得两种高活性肽（WHCSeMAQ和FMSeCSeFFV），它们可通过氢键和疏水键与Keap-1结合，促进Nrf2释放。这两种肽通过调节Nrf2通路，增强抗氧化酶GSH-Px、CAT和SOD的活性，并降低ROS和MDA水平，从而减轻APAP诱导的HepG2细胞肝损伤。此外，蛋清肽-硒螯合物（EWP-Se）能够延长秀丽隐杆线虫的寿命，降低ROS水平，并上调SKN-1靶基因以促进GST-4表达。本研究显示，硒肽作为肝损伤保护剂具有巨大潜力，并为开发具有促进健康特性的硒螯合肽食品提供了理论支持。
